title: Epimorphy of Frobenius minus identity on first additive cohomology
statement: Let f:C -> Spec(k) be a smooth connected curve over an algebraically closed field k of prime characteristic p (def-sc-curves). Let G be an abelian etale sheaf with natural additive section equivalences a_U:G(U) -> Gamma(U,O_U) (def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module). Let wp:G -> G satisfy a_U(wp(x))=a_U(x)^p-a_U(x) on every etale object. Then the map on derived first etale cohomology of G (def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology) induced by wp is epi.

source.place: steps 3--7: the proper/affine argument and first-cohomology Frobenius map

proof.text: Compactification and affineness of a proper curve minus a nonempty finite set show that C is either proper or affine.
In the affine case first additive cohomology is zero, hence any endomorphism is epi.
In the proper case natural section equivalences transport scalar multiplication and Frobenius to G. Additivity of cohomology yields a k-vector space V=H^1(C,G), a p-semilinear F, and H^1(wp)=F-id.
The natural etale/Zariski comparison identifies V linearly with H^1(C,O_C), finite dimensional by proper coherent cohomology.

Lang-Steinberg gives surjectivity of F-id. Compare the map with derived global sections using injective resolutions. For the coefficient universes use finite affine etale hypercover cochains, which identify cocycles, coboundaries and the wp map. A surjective additive-group map is epi.

theorem epi_etaleCohomology_artinSchreier_one
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p]
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (wp : G ⟶ G)
    (ha : ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x))
    (hwp : ∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a U (wp.hom.app U x) = (a U x) ^ p - a U x) :
    Epi ((Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} C (1 : ℤ)).map
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).map wp))
